text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page FIRED for service=redwood-embeddings severity=P1 -> embeddings-queue backlog >95% and 5xx rate rising. link: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/embeds/queue?orgId=1

pagerbot: Auto-escalation: paging rotation -> @Alex G (oncall) :bell:  (pager runbook applied)

Alex G: Taking it. joining bridge now. can someone drop the runbook link?

Jamie L: Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/embeddings-queue-runbook. TL;DR: check autoscaler, worker OOMs, kvcache eviction, and rate-limiter backoff.

Samir P: Quick snapshot from logs: many `err=rpc_unavailable` from embed-worker, and `kvcache_miss` counts spiking. Looks like hot prefix cache eviction combined with a burst of requests.

Alex G: On bridge: 
```
# current pods
kubectl -n inference get hpa,deploy -l app=embeddings-worker
# scale immediate temp
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embeddings-worker --replicas=40
```

Priya N: FYI customer-impact: support reported 3 customers (enterprise) seeing 30-60s latencies + 502s. Notified CS.

SRE-Shift: Noting that Dedicated autoscaler recently deployed change v1.12 -> v1.13 which reduced maxBurst by 50%. Could be related.

Alex G: Patching autoscaler to restore previous burst threshold now. Applying hotfix (dry-run then apply).

pagerbot: change deployed to `autoscaler-config` namespace by Alex G (hash: ab12cd).

Samir P: After scale and autoscaler tweak: 1) queue depth dropped 40% in 4m; 2) 5xx rate decreasing but still above baseline.

Alex G: Rolling back the v1.13 autoscaler limit and enabling temporary higher concurrency: `maxBurst: 200` -> `maxBurst: 400` for 30m window.

Jamie L: I'm going to take ownership for follow-through and customer comms. Alex, ping me if anything regresses.

Alex G: Handing off to Jamie L. Leaving bridge in 10m. current ETA to recovery: ~20-30m.

Priya N: Customer-impact update: CS sent templated note to affected tenants, asking for confirmation if they're still impacted.

SRE-Shift: Monitoring: graphs -> latency p95 trending down from 6s to 1.8s after scale. Keep an eye on KV cache eviction rates.

Jamie L: Taking over. Next steps: 1) keep scaled replicas for 45m; 2) investigate root cause of cache churn (likely patch in kv eviction handshake); 3) prepare rollback plan for autoscaler tweaks after stabilization.

Alex G: Confirm bridge is recorded. Logs attached to incident ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-4521

pagerbot: PD: incident acknowledged by Alex G at 1768888920; reassigned to Jamie L at 1768889400.

Jamie L: Quick note for postmortem: include the autoscaler config diff, customer request spike trace, and timeline from alert -> mitigation. Assigning PM owner: Priya N for customer comms.

Samir P: I'm running a short grep to correlate request IDs to tenants to size scope. will paste list in ticket.

Priya N: CS will wait for final confirmation before sending follow-up. Thanks all.

Jamie L: Final check-in: system stable for last 10m, 5xx back to baseline, queue < 30%. Keeping scaled replicas until 1768893200. Closing active mitigation in 30m unless regression. Postmortem owner: Jamie L.

Alex G: Thanks team. Leaving the channel. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident note appended: "temporary autoscaler burst increase and scale-up mitigated embeddings-queue spike; follow-up PM and postmortem assigned."
